title: The Dire Treeline
description: Ranger Sylas has followed the rot deeper than the vale — into the darkwood itself, where the wolves have grown to twice their size and the bloodthorn coils thick as a man's arm. The path south toward the lake is a killing floor now. Thin the dire wolves and the thornback growth before it swallows the last of the wood-road.

objectives.desc: Cull the dire wolves along the darkwood road
